title: 第463章 我来龙人界只做三件事第462章 工业革命的龙人界
slug: 一年抽取一词条模拟的也可以
lines: 陈奕来龙人界只做三件事。
搜集炼器材料。
挑拨龙人界、圣龙界开战。
用龙人界的大地之灵酝养人界的五行根器。
陈奕手中的四件根器中，器身损毁最严重的是乾坤镜，而器灵损毁最严重的其实并非九州鼎，而是山河甲。
因为山河甲现在压根没有器灵。
想把器灵重新养出来，难度比养出器身只高不低——五行根器来源于天地演化，不是靠寻常炼器手段诞生的，所以不能通过炼器恢复。
所以，龙人界的大地之灵不能放过。
用最好的大地之灵，修复损毁最严重的根器。
毕竟修复五行根器这个事，也得考虑一下时间成本。
越早修复五行根器，对陈奕提防黑手越有利，这是毋庸置疑的。
依旧是让绚岚五杰去搜集材料。
这五个老哥彼此看了看，他们现在已经全和陈奕一样，变成了圣龙人的模样。
“大人的易容术虽夺天地之造化，但圣龙人是会化龙变身的，我们似乎并没有这种能力。”
陈奕倒是可以变。
不过考虑到绚岚他们只是去搜集材料，不是到处搞事干架的，真碰上情况跑路就行了。
绚岚五杰走后，索托斐仁跃跃欲试的说道。
“老大，咱们还是如法炮制，找出这龙人界的少主，然后乃伊做特呗？”
陈奕摇摇头。
“不，这次，我们要直接干掉龙人界主！”
“啊？为什么呢？”
“据我所知，龙人族都很渴望进步，要是最顶上那个位子空缺了，意味着底下的人全有机会晋升，那你想想后面会发生什么呢？”
“肯定乱成一团，内斗不止！妙哉，妙哉，干掉一个人，引发全界混乱！”
“不单如此，为了成为新的界主，那些野心勃勃之辈势必要拉拢人心树立威望，既然是圣龙人杀死了先主，新主获得人心最好的方式，就是为先主报仇。”
“漂亮！如此一来，处于内斗中的龙人族再和圣龙族开战，双方一定会斗个头破血流，难分高下！”
索托斐仁一副看热闹不嫌事大的样子。
同时，他也在心里庆幸。
还好他们翼界没有得到圣龙界、龙人界这种对待，不然全完了。
这次在动手之前，陈奕得先完成寄养山河甲这件事。
不然等龙人界乱起来，他想找个能做主的人都难。
所以，陈奕先恢复本貌，带着同样变的人模人样的索托斐仁寻找龙人界主去了。
两个人族在龙人界上空大摇大摆的飞行，没一会儿就引来了一队龙人。
“哎呦我去！老子刚刚还以为看错了，没想到真是人族啊！”
这队龙人穿着一身甲胄，是下方一片厂房的守卫。
见天上有人不按飞行条例乱飞就上来看看。
不看不知道，一看吓一跳，龙人界里竟然出现了人族！
这队龙人都是武王境。
拿武王当保安用，龙人界还是很奢侈的。
“你们两个是从哪偷渡过来的？老实交代，我们给你留个全尸，哈哈哈！”
眼见这几个龙人这么没眼力见，和自己老大这么说话，索托斐仁当场火就上来了。
“区区化气前期，如此目中无人，活腻了吗！”
content_en:
Chen Yi came to the dragon world to do only three things.
Collect refining materials.
Instigate a war between the Dragon Realm and the Holy Dragon Realm.
Use the spirit of the earth from the dragon-human world to nourish the five elements of the human world.
Among the four root artifacts in Chen Yi's hands, the one with the most severely damaged body was the Qiankun Mirror, while the one with the most severely damaged spirit was actually not the Kyushu Cauldron, but the Mountain and River Armor.
Because Shanhejia has no weapon spirit at all now.
Raising the weapon spirit again is just as difficult as raising the weapon body - the Five Elements root weapon comes from the evolution of heaven and earth and is not born through ordinary weapon refining methods, so it cannot be restored through weapon refining.
Therefore, the spirit of the earth in the dragon world cannot be let go.
Use the best earth spirit to repair the most damaged roots.
After all, when it comes to repairing the Five Elements Root Device, you have to consider the time cost.
There is no doubt that the sooner the Five Elements Root Device is repaired, the better it will be for Chen Yi to guard against evil hands.
It was still up to the Five Elites of Xuanlan to collect materials.
These five brothers looked at each other. They had all turned into the Holy Dragon like Chen Yi.
"Although your master's disguise technique has conquered the heaven and earth, the Holy Dragon people can transform into dragons. We don't seem to have this ability."
Chen Yi can change.
However, considering that Xuanlan and the others were only there to collect materials, not to cause trouble, they could just run away if the situation happened.
After the five heroes of Xianlan left, Sotoferen said eagerly.
"Boss, let's do the same thing and find the young master of the dragon world, and then we can do something special?"
Chen Yi shook his head.
"No, this time, we are going to kill the Dragon Realm Master directly!"
"Ah? Why?"
"As far as I know, the dragon tribe is very eager to progress. If the top position is vacant, it means that all the people below have the opportunity to be promoted. Then think about what will happen next?"
"There will definitely be chaos and internal fighting! How wonderful, how wonderful, killing one person will trigger chaos in the whole world!"
"Not only that, in order to become the new world master, those ambitious people must win over the people and establish their prestige. Since it was the Holy Dragon who killed the former master, the best way for the new master to win the hearts of the former master is to avenge the former master."
"Beautiful! If this happens, if the Dragon Clan, which is in internal fighting, starts a war with the Holy Dragon Clan, the two sides will definitely fight to the death, and it will be difficult to tell the difference!"
Sotoferen looked like he was just watching the fun and not taking it too seriously.
At the same time, he was also grateful in his heart.
Fortunately, their Wing Realm did not receive such treatment from the Holy Dragon Realm and the Dragon Human Realm, otherwise it would be all over.
Before taking action this time, Chen Yi had to complete the matter of fostering Shanhejia.
Otherwise, when chaos breaks out in the dragon world, it will be difficult for him to find someone who can take the lead.
Therefore, Chen Yixian restored his original appearance and took Sotoferen, who had also changed into a human-like appearance, to look for the Lord of the Dragon Realm.
The two human races flew swaggeringly over the dragon world, and soon attracted a group of dragon people.
"Oh, let me go! I thought I saw it wrong just now, but I didn't expect it was really a human race!"
This team of dragon men were wearing armor and were the guards of a factory building below.
If you see someone in the sky flying around in violation of flight regulations, come up and take a look.
You wouldn’t know it if you didn’t look at it, but you would be shocked to see that there is a human race in the world of dragons!
This team of dragons are all in the Martial King realm.
Using King Wu as a security guard is still very luxurious in the dragon world.
"Where did you two sneak over from? Be honest and we will leave you with a complete body, hahaha!"
Seeing that these dragon men were so ignorant and talking to their boss like this, Sotoferen became angry on the spot.
"You are just in the early stage of Qi transformation, so arrogant, are you tired of living like this!"
title_en: Chapter 463: I came to the Dragon Realm to do only three things Chapter 462: The Dragon Realm of the Industrial Revolution
